FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF HORANA URBAN COUNCIL UNDER
SECTION 66A (1) (a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member in Horana Urban Council has fallen vacant by reason of Death;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna, the recognized Political Party to whichBalage Don Vipula Rohana Kulasiri the member belonged, was required by me under section 66A (1) (a) of the aforesaidOrdinance, to decide upon the member of that Ward Number 03 - Munagama West of Horana Urban Council who belongs tosuch party and is not disqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shallbe declared elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party has communicated his decision tonominate Perumpulle Mudiyanselage Ajith Munasingha to fill such vacancy;

NOW THEREFORE I, Hannedige Rasika Priyanga Peiris, Returning Officer of Horana Urban Council, acting interms of Section 66A (1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that PerumpulleMudiyanselage Ajith Munasingha was elected as the member of the Ward Number 03 - Munagama West of Horana UrbanCouncil.
RASIKA PEIRIS,Returning Officer,Horana Urban Council.
District Election Office,Kalutara.31st July, 2018.
